import sys

from more_itertools import sliced, split_at, split_before, split_after, split_when

# Test original behavior (maxsplit=None is default)
print("=== Original behavior without maxsplit ===")
print("sliced:", list(sliced((1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), 3)))

print("split_after:", list(split_after('one1two2', lambda s: s.isdigit())))
print("split_after range:", list(split_after(range(10), lambda n: n % 3 == 0)))
print("split_when:", list(split_when('abcde', lambda x, y: x > y)))

print("\nAll original behaviors preserved!")
